description: Operates this computer's apps through accessibility, with window screenshots as a fallback. action: list_apps; get_app_state (app) reads the app's accessibility tree, one element per line as [index] Role "title" …, launching it if needed; click (element_index, or x and y in the latest screenshot's pixels; mouse_button, click_count); drag (from_x, from_y, to_x, to_y); type_text (text) into the focused element; press_key (key such as Return, Escape, ctrl+a, or cmd+shift+z on a Mac); set_value (element_index, value); select_text (element_index, text, prefix, suffix, selection_type); scroll (element_index, direction, pages); perform_secondary_action (element_index, ax_action such as ShowMenu, Increment or activate). Every action but list_apps needs app: a display name, a bundle identifier or .app path on macOS, or a .desktop id or executable name on Linux. Each action returns the app's new state, or only what changed, where lines it leaves out keep their index; use indexes only from the latest state. screenshot adds a JPEG of the app's window; get_app_state includes one unless screenshot is false. Terminals, password managers and system authentication dialogs are refused. Ask before submitting, sending, buying or deleting anything the user did not ask for.
name: computer

full.description: get_app_state: the whole tree instead of what changed.
